Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/ndpi && python3 -c "
import struct
f = open('tests/pcap/tls-rdn-extract.pcap','rb')
data = f.read()
magic = struct.unpack('<I', data[0:4])[0]
endian = '<' if magic == 0xa1b2c3d4 else '>'
off = 24
while off < len(data):
    ts_sec, ts_usec, incl_len, orig_len = struct.unpack(endian+'IIII', data[off:off+16])
    off += 16
    pkt = data[off:off+incl_len]
    off += incl_len
    if len(pkt) < 54: continue
    ihl = (pkt[14] & 0x0f)*4
    if pkt[23] != 6: continue
    tcp_off = 14+ihl
    doff = (pkt[tcp_off+12] >> 4)*4
    payload = pkt[tcp_off+doff:]
    i = 0
    while i < len(payload)-4:
        if payload[i] == 0x16:
            ln = struct.unpack('>H', payload[i+3:i+5])[0]
            rec = payload[i:i+5+ln]
            if ln > 0 and rec[5] == 0x0b:
                body = rec[5:]
                # find 55 1d 11
                idx = body.find(bytes.fromhex('551d11'))
                if idx >= 0:
                    print('found 55 1d 11 at body offset', idx)
                    print('context:', body[idx-4:idx+40].hex())
            i += 5+ln
        else:
            i += 1
